description: Assignments for one Canvas course. Pass course_id as the Canvas course ID or as the course name, for example "Networking 1", and get due dates, points and submission status: not submitted, submitted, graded, missing or excused. Set bucket to filter, for example overdue. Example: "Which Canvas assignments in Networking 1 are overdue?"

bucket.description: Optional filter, for example overdue or upcoming.

course_id.description: Canvas course ID, the number Canvas shows for the course, or the course name such as "Networking 1". Ask get_my_courses for the list of IDs and names.

name: get_assignments
title: Course assignments
